items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: I copied for Brookmeyer and I copied for Rayburn Wright and Bill Dobbins, Donald Hunsberger with all the wind ensemble stuff, Joseph Schwantner, Bob Belden in New York, I’ve done some work for Maria Schneider.

ctx.x: So what are those things that you should be trying to do before you go there?

What I think about is continuing to develop whatever material is going on before I turn it over to a soloist. And so whether that’s a melodic idea or if then oh well I did this so it was kind of a straightforward thing so maybe I’ll do some kind of a counterpoint that’s an inversion or a retrograde inversion of what the main material was. You know I just play around with — until it feels right to release my thing to a soloist. And what I’ve begun doing in the last few years, which also comes from Brookmeyer, is I…
Yeah. You put them in caps.
